verdict.rationale: Firstbase's pricing page documents a mailroom with "unlimited incoming mail, scans" and "unlimited digital storage", plus "digitize files in-app". It also offers registered-agent service in all 50 states, which implies it receives state mail. However, no evidence explicitly ties registered-agent legal or state documents to the scanned online account, and nothing shows the read, download, or share functions. Missing for 10: explicit scanning of registered-agent/state legal notices into the account, documented download and sharing of scanned documents, independent or hands-on corroboration.
